episodes.title: Nobody claps at 5 AM

scenes.vo: Five A.M. Nobody's watching.
No crowd. No likes. Just you, and the work.
Day one feels like nothing. So does day thirty.
Then one day, someone asks how you got so lucky.
It was never luck. It was every quiet morning nobody saw.

scenes.vo: Same twenty four hours. Same phone. Same excuses.
One scrolls till midnight. One builds, one hour at a time.
One percent better a day doesn't look like much.
But a year later, these two are complete strangers.
So which one are you going to be today?

episodes.title: Get up anyway

scenes.vo: So you fell. And everyone saw it.
Here's what they didn't see. You got up anyway.
The weight doesn't get lighter. You get stronger.
The easy road was right there. You took the hard one.
That's it. That's the whole secret.

episodes.title: Just two minutes

scenes.vo: Can't make yourself start? Then don't try to finish.
Just do two minutes. Two pushups. Two pages. Two lines.
Two minutes turns into ten. Ten turns into a habit.
And habits quietly build the person you want to be.
Start small. But start now.

episodes.title: Make future you proud

scenes.vo: Somewhere ahead, there's a version of you who made it.
Every choice today is a vote. For him, or against him.
The couch or the gym. The phone, or the book.
He isn't waiting at the top. He's built on every step.
Make him proud.
